title: Pikachu soft toy
lede: A yellow plush Pikachu from the late-1990s Pokémon boom: a round body, stubby limbs, dot eyes with highlights, and red cheek discs.
summary: Seated yellow plush Pikachu with black-tipped ears and round red cheeks. Made in Germany, 1995–1999.

creator.name: Deutshe Toy GMBH (manufacturer, as the V&A spells it); Pokémon created by Satoshi Tajiri

evidence.note: Inspected the V&A photograph 2006AE8391 of object B.89-2004 (1200 × 1600 px, IIIF) in a scratchpad copy. Not stored.

styles.note: Partial fit: the big round head, short limbs, highlighted dot eyes, and blush circles are the kawaii face, but the yellow is strong rather than pastel.

context: The V&A says Pokémon was created by Satoshi Tajiri as games for Nintendo’s Game Boy in 1995, then moved to television, trading cards, and merchandise including soft toys; it calls Pikachu “probably the best known of the Pokémon creatures”. [V&A B.89-2004](https://collections.vam.ac.uk/item/O107469/pikachu-soft-toy/).

The museum records a yellow nylon plush toy, 275 mm high, with black plastic eyes with white dots, cheeks of plastic discs covered in red material, and a stitched nose and mouth, manufactured in Munich. [V&A B.89-2004](https://collections.vam.ac.uk/item/O107469/pikachu-soft-toy/).
observed: The toy sits upright; the head is almost as wide as the body, and the arms and feet are short rounded stubs.
The eyes are black domes with a white highlight, set wide and low; the mouth is a small stitched wavy line under a dot nose.
Two bright red circles mark the cheeks.
The long ears end in black tips; the plush is an even lemon yellow.
interpretation: The face follows the kawaii formula almost exactly: wide-set highlighted dot eyes, a tiny mouth, and cheek blush. The proportions are those of the chibi baby schema.
The saturated yellow shows that the kawaii face and proportions can work without the pastel palette, in the toy and game branch of the style.
borrow: Place dot eyes wide apart and low on the face, each with one small white highlight.
Make cheek blush a clean circle in a single warm color.
